rationale: The assistant asked the right first check (unplugged, turn drum by hand), then correctly concluded a snapped or slipped drive belt, which matches the ground truth. It was properly hedged ('snapped or slipped off') and told the customer to order parts by model number without claiming a specific part fits. Weaknesses: it did not ask for the full model number or serial, did not mention the jockey pulley to replace alongside, did not suggest looking for the belt with a torch, and gave no safety cautions about sharp edges or the capacitor, and ended abruptly with thin guidance on fitting.
